extraction.Name: Rosa DuBray Iron Shell
extraction.Refused/Protested: I did not expect it at all, but after it was received I was told by several people that I would have to pay taxes on the land so might as well take it. I do not remember who told me that but some people.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I first mortgaged then sold it.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: after it was received I was told by several people that I would have to pay taxes on the land so might as well take it
extraction.Occupation/Income: By my husband who works here and there.
extraction.NOTES: Did not make application for patent; patent received in the mail in April 1920. Was to receive $3500.00 for the land but received approximately $1500 in all, part of which was a used Ford touring car valued at $500.00. Each party she dealt with blamed the other for not paying the remainder; Mr. Covey died and blame was put on him. Has five children. She and her husband are in good health. Notarized March 27, 1929, before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
